messages:
Ken R: opening canary for 'pegasus-tiny' (int4) with parse_granularity="token". onboarding shows a failure mode where repair heuristics that insert commas/closers sometimes end up adding a top-level "debug" field in downstream payloads. not great. :grimacing:
Lina V: minimal broken trace (chunks):
```json
{"tool_call":{"name":"search","args":"{\"q\":\"blue widgets\"}"}
...next chunk...
,"debug":true}}
```
Marco P: so if we naively append a closer to the first chunk we can later reattach the comma+debug and create a payload with debug present even when it shouldn't be. we need to avoid repairs that invent top-level keys.
Sasha Y: suggested approach: after any repair, run strict schema validation. accept repair only if the set of top-level keys after repair is a subset of the keys we can detect heuristically from the raw concatenation (i.e., don't accept newly invented top-level names).
Ken R: how do we detect keys from a broken concatenation without parsing? regex is brittle because of strings/escapes. better: walk the char stream, track depth, ignore chars inside strings (respecting escapes), and record keys seen at depth==1. we have similar code in parser-lib we can reuse.
Lina V: implementation sketch:
```py
# pseudocode
def top_level_keys_heuristic(raw):
    keys = set()
    i = 0
    depth = 0
    in_str = False
    while i < len(raw):
        c = raw[i]
        if c == '\"' and not escaped:
            in_str = not in_str
        elif not in_str:
            if c == '{': depth += 1
            elif c == '}': depth -= 1
            elif depth == 1 and c == '\"':
                # parse key string, add to set
                key = parse_string_at(raw, i)
                keys.add(key)
                advance i accordingly
        handle escapes and increments
    return keys
```
We'll reuse parser-lib helpers for string scanning.
Marco P: tests we need:
- positive: chunk split inside a value (repair should pass)
- negative: chunk where missing separator creates apparent new key (repair must be rejected)
- adversarial: escaped quotes and backslashes at boundary
Also monitor metrics: repair_accept_rate, schema_violation_post_repair, parse_fail_rate.
Sasha Y: rollout policy: opt-in flag `conservative_repair=keysafe`, default off. gate at 0.5% canary, stop if schema_violation_post_repair > baseline + 0.02%.
lint-bot: baseline snapshot: parse_fail_rate=0.58% ; estimated keysafe drop=0.35% (proj) ; schema_violation_delta=PENDING
Lina V: i'll run a replay cb-pegasus-1812 with keysafe enabled once PRs land and post the dashboard link. will also scrub any PII from traces and ping security.
Ken R: action items:
- Marco: open PR for keysafe repair impl + unit tests (include replay harness snippets)
- Lina: add negative/adversarial tests and run replay when PR merges
- Sasha: schedule 24h 0.5% canary and monitor thresholds; prepare rollback playbook
Ken R: thanks team. we'll reconvene after the canary run. :thumbsup:
